chiru: Khan makha mun kha mak a ama kho tieng rushe joi, khan akhaichawi hai na ama kha rujui uh.
english: Then He went out from there and came to His own country, and His disciples followed Him.

chiru: Khan Sabbath nikho hawng nih phakhan, synagogue ah miruchuh ruput. Rangai mi tampui kha shinrudawng pe ua amani na ruti uh, Hi miring hi na hihaihi khoshekawt a imuk maw nih?
english: And when the Sabbath had come, He began to teach in the synagogue. And many hearing Him were astonished

chiru: Mahi James le Joses, khan Juda le Simon ulienpa, Mariam shapa, thingthiempa kha nimak maw?
english: Is this not the carpenter, the Son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon?

chiru: Khan Jesu na amani dieng ruriei, Thiempulien khat hi ama khotak, ama inkoshangramtak le ama inshungkhurtak dieng niboia, richit kha imuk boi nimak.
english: But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor except in his own country

chiru: Khan kha mun khan, ana dikhat chung ah ukhut le shit a irumadam kha niboia, ranakniei chon khatshe ruthawlai mak.
english: Now He could do no mighty work there, except that He laid His hands on a few sick people

chiru: Khan amani takashawn boi khan shinrudawng pe. Khan khokho ah miruchuh rang rushe joi.
english: And He marveled because of their unbelief. Then He went about the villages in a circuit, teaching.

chiru: Khan ama na shawmlieidi kha rukoi a raikho rono hai kha nawtna rang, cham kha rupek a ididi a rawtawpmashak a atir ruput joi.
english: And He called the twelve to Himself, and began to send them out two by two

chiru: Ama na amani dieng chawng rupek, makhala khomijin nangshena u khan shunshawraw khat niboia, nekleshak, pai, khan kawngkhit a shier chawi u naw roh.
english: He commanded them to take nothing for the journey except a staff

chiru: Khan kethawp thaw u roh, khan kotai idi ko u naw roh.
english: but to wear sandals, and not to put on two tunics.

chiru: Khan amani dieng ruriei, Nanglutna ih in khan nita`awm, makha mun ah put ah nangrawthawt u malalim, kha mun khan awm u roh.
english: Also He said to them, In whatever place you enter a house, stay there till you depart

chiru: Makhan mi hai na nangni kha thaning a nurujawng u nawk a, khan nangiriei u kha narangai pe u nawkatu, makha nangmathan a nangshe dieng u khan, amani chung a kungchangna rang, nang kepha u thoi ah vaiphin kha khawng u roh.
english: shake off the dust under your feet as a testimony against them.

chiru: Khan mi hai na mulung lekna rang, amani na rushe ua chawng vak shem uh.
english: So they went out and preached that people should repent.

chiru: Khan raikho tampui runawt pe uh, khan ana hai tampui kha thaorunawt pe ua rumadam uh.
english: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many who were sick, and healed them.

chiru: Khan Jesu riming kha ajeng a rular jarkhan, Herod reng na rujet a ruti, Baptisma apeh John hi athi hai kar a hawng thoi joi.
english: Now King Herod heard of Him, for His name had become well known.

chiru: Eshen na ama kha Elijah keng, ruti uh, inia eshen na tu ama kha Thiempulien khat, ninawkle thiempulien hai le ra`ang akhat inih, ruti uh.
english: Others said, It is Elijah. And others said, It is the Prophet

chiru: Herod na rujet `le, ruti, Kiei na ring kitan pe John kha hawng ring joi!
english: But when Herod heard, he said, This is John, whom I beheaded; he has been raised!

chiru: Ajarla Herod amatak na ama ulienpa Philip nupuinu Herodia kha iruniei inih. Khajarkhan John kha irushur, khan lungroko shung ah khop a irutet inih.
english: For Herod himself had sent and laid hold of John, and bound him in prison

chiru: Ajarla John na Herod dieng ruti, Nang ulienpa nupuinu nangiloi hi Dan nimak.
english: Because John had said to Herod, It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife.

chiru: Mahi jar hin, Herodia na rumukmak a ama kha thatna rang, rumining; inia ama na ruthaw ngam mak.
english: Therefore Herodias held it against him and wanted to kill him, but she could not;

chiru: Ajarla Herod na John kha midik le miriethieng, iti rujet jarkhan, ruchih a ama kha irurung inih.
english: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just and holy man, and he protected him.

chiru: Khan chanthatna nikho khat hawng shok joi, makhala Herod shokna nikho hin chamniei hai, chonpo hai, ramiring tieng a alien hai le Galilee tieng ah alienarang hai rang bumichinna khat runiei.
english: Then an opportune day came when Herod on his birthday gave a feast

chiru: Hipha hin Herodia shanu hawng lut a hawng lam. Herod le ama dieng ah buneh rang a ashuh hai kha ningruminit pe.
english: And when Herodias' daughter herself came in and danced, and pleased Herod

chiru: Khan ama dieng chawngrurakham, Ih kha nita`awm nieriei roh, kerengchangna khoi khat nita`awm, nang dieng nepek rang kanih.
english: He also swore to her, Whatever you ask me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom.

chiru: Khan ama na rushe a unu dieng vak rawdawn, Kiei na imaw nih ning? Baptisma apeh John lu, tia unu na rumashang.
english: So she went out and said to her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist!

chiru: Khan ama na rengpa dieng pangrek a vak nik a ruti, Tuntak hin baptisma apeh John lu kha rangmai chung hin nanginepek rang a hi kadit.
english: Immediately she came in with haste to the king and asked, saying, I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter.

chiru: Makhan rengpa kha ajeng a mulungrushaw pe. Inia ama chawngrakham le iedieng ah ishut pui koimiring hai jarkhan, jawt pe boi, iti ruthawlai mak.
english: And the king was exceedingly sorry; yet, because of the oaths and because of those who sat with him, he did not want to refuse her.

chiru: Khan rengpa kha na relentak a mimahangpa kha vak mokoi a ama lu kha vak chawina rang, chawng rupek joi.
english: Immediately the king sent an executioner and commanded his head to be brought.

chiru: Khan ama na rushe a lungroko shung ah awm John kha ring vak tuk pe joi. Kheng khat ah John lu kha vak chawi a nungaknu dieng vak pek a nungaknu kha na makha unu dieng rupek joi.
english: And he went and beheaded him in prison, brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl

chiru: Khan John khaichawi hai na rujet u phakhan, rushe ua ama rok kha vak loi uh, khan than ah makha vak khum u joi.
english: When his disciples heard of it, they came and took away his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

chiru: Khan tirtawn hai kha na Jesu dieng vak ruchun ua iruthaw u le iruruchuk u kholok chungchanga thangrukoi uh.
english: Then the apostles gathered to Jesus and told Him all things, both what they had done and what they had taught.

chiru: Khan amani dieng ruti, Thawh, nangni richinkhat ramthimna mun ah shik a shawvakmuchum u roh. Ajarla mi tampui shehawng a awm jarkhan, bu nekna rangshe chanthatna runiei u lai mak.
english: And He said to them, Come aside by yourselves to a deserted place and rest a while.

chiru: Khajarkhan lawpte u hin ramthimna mun ah rokong a rushe u joi.
english: So they departed to a deserted place in the boat by themselves.

chiru: Khan amani rushe u kha mirawp na rumuk uh. Khan mipui kha na rujet u jarkhan, khopui rikip miring hai kha na vak tan ua matieng rushok uh, khan ama dieng lawp khat a vak ruchun u joi.
english: But the multitudes saw them departing, and many knew Him and ran there on foot from all the cities.

chiru: Makhan Jesu na kawmchang tieng hawng phakhan, mirawp kha vak muk `le, kengamroi awm boi kengam hai kha ruang u jarkhan, amani chung a lainatna runiei.
english: And Jesus, when He came out, saw a great multitude and was moved with compassion

chiru: Khan nikhothang shawtbawt `le, akhaichawi hai na ama dieng she a ruti uh, Mahi mun hi ramthim inih, khan apha`awm shemeng joi.
english: When the day was now far spent, His disciples came to Him and said, This is a deserted place, and already the hour is late.

chiru: Amani hi diengvai ah awm khopui le kho hai dieng tan vak rawchawkna u rang, tir rang roh. Ajarla nekleshak khatshe niei u lai mak.
english: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread

chiru: Makhan mashang a amani dieng ruti, Amani kha shak rang dikhat peh u roh. Makhan amani na rumashang uh, Kieini na she a dinari rajadi a tan vak rawchawk a amani dieng kipek u rang maw nih?
english: But He answered and said to them, You give them something to eat.

chiru: Makhan amani dieng rumashang, Nangni na tanpek ijat maw nangniei uh? She u tana vak en u roh. Khan amani na rujet ua ruti uh, Tanpek rahnga le nga idi awm.
english: But He said to them, How many loaves do you have? Go and see. And when they found out they said, Five, and two fish.

chiru: Khan kholok kha lawplawp a champi chung ah mushutna rang, amani dieng chawng rupek joi.
english: Then He commanded them to make them all sit down in groups on the green grass.

chiru: Khan amani na hawi rajakhat a le hawi shawm rahnga a lawplawp a rushuh u joi.
english: So they sat down in ranks, in hundreds and in fifties.

chiru: Khan ama na tanpek rahnga le nga idi kha loi a ravan tieng en a rahvan runik. Khan tan hai kha okhoi a amani dieng shemna rang, akhaichawi hai dieng rupek.
english: And when He had taken the five loaves and the two fish, He looked up to heaven, blessed and broke the loaves

chiru: Khan amani kholok na rushak ua vawn ruship pe uh.
english: So they all ate and were filled.

chiru: Khan lekvai le nga hai kha tiengkum shawmlieidi shipmer a rurawkhawm uh.
english: And they took up twelve baskets full of fragments and of the fish.

chiru: Aneh-ashah apa hai kha bawp rahnga runih uh.
english: Now those who had eaten the loaves were about five thousand men.

chiru: Khan mipui kha rureshen pui laitak khan, akhaichawi hai kha thampui shir khat ah awm Bethsaida tieng rokong a rurelenmashak joi.
english: Immediately He made His disciples get into the boat and go before Him to the other side, to Bethsaida

chiru: Khan amani kha le mathanna chawngruriei shole, anih rang lawn tieng ruhawng joi.
english: And when He had sent them away, He departed to the mountain to pray.

chiru: Khan nitak pha hawng shok `le, rokong kha thampui laitak ah ruawm joi, inia ama tu, mo khan iethien a ruawmlai.
english: Now when evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea; and He was alone on the land.

chiru: Khan rithi na maton khar a rang jarkhan, amani shawna kha rumuk pe. Khan voimili changna vengpa pha khan, thampui chung ah vak lawn a amani dieng rushe a amani kha khe rang ruthaw.
english: Then He saw them straining at rowing, for the wind was against them. Now about the fourth watch of the night He came to them, walking on the sea

chiru: Khan tui chung ah vak lawn kha amani na rumuk u `le, rathamieshie keng ti ua amani na rura`ai uh.
english: And when they saw Him walking on the sea, they supposed it was a ghost, and cried out;

chiru: Ajarla amani kholok na ama kha muk u `le, rurawthawk uh. Relentak a amani le riebieh a ruriei, Nang mulung mangar u roh! Kiei kanih keng; chih u naw roh.
english: for they all saw Him and were troubled. But immediately He talked with them and said to them, Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid.

chiru: Khan amani awmna rokong khan, hawng ka a rithi kha rubang joi, khan ibibing ua rekhenna awm boi a shinrudawng pe uh.
english: Then He went up into the boat to them, and the wind ceased. And they were greatly amazed

chiru: Ajarla amani mulung rumichim pe u joi jarkhan, amani na tanpek chungchanga chonshok khan, shingna ruman u mak.
english: For they had not understood about the loaves, because their heart was hardened.

chiru: Khan amani na rurakan ua Gennesaret ram kha vak shok u joi. Khan rokong kha makha kawmchang khan ruthung uh.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret and anchored there.

chiru: Rokong ah put ah ruchumphit u `le, mi hai na ama me kha rujetrelen uh.
english: And when they came out of the boat, immediately the people recognized Him,

chiru: Khan akieiakiei ah rutan ua amani na ama awm, tina mun khan, ana hai kha jana le dawmlam a vak chawi uh.
english: ran through that whole surrounding region, and began to carry about on beds those who were sick

chiru: Khan ama lutnalutna: kho ah nit a, khopui ah nit a, inleloi mun ah nita`awm, ana hai kha rievieithawna mun a rutet uh. Ama pon rieshiei mawrtaka kha nita`awm mishitna rang, ama dieng runik uh. Khan ponmawr ashih miring rikip kha irumadam inih.
english: Wherever He entered, into villages, cities, or the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged Him that they might just touch the hem of His garment. And as many as touched Him were made well.
